marketSummary: Indian benchmark equities staged a massive relief rally, with the Sensex surging 1,533.72 points (+2.11%) to 74,315.61 and Nifty 50 reclaiming the 23,000 threshold at 22,997.35 (+1.66%). Upside momentum was fueled by heavy buying in IT heavyweights post strong Q2 prints, alongside Reliance Industries rallying on official filing details of Jio Platforms' mega ₹30,213 crore IPO. However, mid-cap and small-cap breadth showed marked divergence, signaling that swing traders should focus on high-relative-strength large-caps and disciplined base breakouts rather than chasing over-extended beta.
dailyFocus: Watch for follow-through continuation across IT and Large-cap defensives after major earnings beats and corporate actions, while monitoring base defense in defence names (BEL, HAL, COCHINSHIP) navigating fresh order flows and capex disclosures.

news.headline: Polycab India Q2 Net Profit Soars 43% YoY to ₹977 Crore on 53% Revenue Growth
news.summary: Polycab India announced a 43% YoY jump in Q2 FY27 standalone net profit to ₹977 crore, driven by robust domestic cables and wires infrastructure demand, with operational revenue accelerating 53% YoY.
news.impact: Substantial earnings beat reinforces high relative strength, sparking potential volume breakout over prior swing pivot resistance.

news.headline: Tech Mahindra Surges on Q2 PAT Jump of 32.7% YoY; Announces 1:1 Bonus Issue and ₹15 Dividend
news.summary: Tech Mahindra reported a 32.7% YoY surge in consolidated net profit to ₹1,586 crore for Q2 FY27, with revenue growing 15.6% to ₹16,180 crore. The board declared an interim dividend of ₹15 per share alongside a 1:1 bonus share issue.
news.impact: Bonus issue announcement and margin expansion provide strong volume thrust for a stage-one base breakout above prior multi-week range resistance.

news.headline: Reliance Industries Catalyzed by ₹30,213 Crore Jio Platforms IPO Price Band Announcement
news.summary: Reliance subsidiary Jio Platforms set its IPO price band at ₹1,065–₹1,119 per share to raise ₹30,213 crore entirely via fresh issue from October 21 to 23, 2026. The filing confirms a ₹2,500 crore shareholder quota.
news.impact: Value-unlocking event provides immediate catalyst support, propelling RIL out of a multi-week consolidation base on above-average delivery volume.

news.headline: Wipro Posts Q2 FY27 Operating Margin Expansion to 16.5%; IT Services Revenue Rises 9.1% YoY
news.summary: Wipro reported Q2 FY27 gross revenue of ₹24,753 crore, climbing 9.1% YoY, while operating margins expanded 50 bps sequentially to 16.5%. The company highlighted large strategic deal renewals in US banking and artificial intelligence systems.
news.impact: Margin expansion beat triggers strong momentum follow-through, lifting price clear of its 50-DMA congestion zone.

news.headline: Cochin Shipyard Maps ₹6,000 Crore Expansion Across Kochi and Thoothukudi
news.summary: Cochin Shipyard is planning a ₹6,000 crore capital expenditure program across Vallarpadam in Kochi and Thoothukudi to expand large-hull commercial shipbuilding, steel fabrication, and naval vessel repair capacities amid burgeoning order backlogs.
news.impact: Major long-term capacity expansion enhances multi-quarter earnings visibility, solidifying swing support at the lower boundary of its multi-month consolidation channel.

news.headline: Bharat Electronics Secures Fresh Orders Worth ₹533 Crore Across Drones and Electronic Warfare
news.summary: Bharat Electronics Limited announced additional order inflows of ₹533 crore since its September 17 update, covering avionics, jammers, drones, and cybersecurity systems under SEBI Regulation 30. Standalone order book remains solid above ₹72,250 crore.
news.impact: Continuous order execution supports the right-side build of a cup-and-handle pattern near key moving average support.

news.headline: Nestle India Slumps 8% Post Q2 Results Over Second-Half Volume Moderation Flags
news.summary: Nestle India shares extended declines to ₹1,262 following an 8% drop after reporting Q2 earnings. Despite a 36% rise in net profit, international brokerages flagged second-half revenue moderation and rising input inflation in commodity baskets.
news.impact: Sharp breakdown below short-term moving average support invalidates cup structures, warning against bottom-fishing until a distinct basing pattern forms.

news.headline: Nifty Snaps Back 374 Points to Close at 22,997 on Heavyweight Short-Covering
news.summary: The Nifty 50 posted its sharpest single-day percentage gain in weeks (+1.66%) to settle at 22,997.35, led by private banks, IT, and telecom, though broader small-caps fell 1.3%, signaling narrow large-cap-driven index leadership.
news.impact: Reclaiming the 20-DMA sets up a technical test of 23,180–23,200 resistance; traders should demand base confirmation given the mid-cap divergence.

news.headline: HAL Navigates Tejas Mk1A Delivery Scrutiny with ₹2.54 Lakh Crore Order Visibility
news.summary: HAL remains under delivery timeline monitoring by the Indian Air Force for the 180-unit LCA Mk1A program amid engine delivery schedules, while long-term revenue visibility remains supported by an order backlog exceeding ₹2.54 lakh crore.
news.impact: Delivery delay headlines keep price oscillating in a wide secondary consolidation band, requiring patient base-building before trend resumption.

news.headline: CG Power Schedules Board Meeting on October 23, 2026 to Consider Q2 FY27 Results
news.summary: CG Power and Industrial Solutions notified exchanges under Regulation 29 that its board of directors will convene on Friday, October 23, 2026, to review and approve standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026.
news.impact: Event date established; price action is likely to undergo volatility contraction inside its secondary consolidation base leading up to October 23.

news.headline: Trent Sets October 29 for Full Q2 FY27 Earnings Following 23% Standalone Sales Jump
news.summary: Following its Q2 business update reporting a 23% YoY surge in revenue to ₹5,788 crore and opening its 1,000th Zudio outlet, Trent has slated its board meeting for October 29, 2026, to approve unaudited Q2 FY27 financial results.
news.impact: After an initial 10-12% post-update gap, the stock is consolidating in high tight flag fashion ahead of the October 29 full margin and PAT confirmation.
